## Kustomize composition roots

Most system and platform components are packaged as Helm charts. Kustomize roots remain composition or workload-overlay boundaries, with `platform/hpc-ubiq` carrying legacy HPC/Slurm overlays that are documented in `docs/architecture/kustomize-helm.md`.

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `platform/hpc-ubiq` | Kustomize overlay/composition root |
| `platform/hpc-ubiq/slurm/base` | Kustomize overlay/composition root |
| `platform/hpc-ubiq/slurm/lh` | Kustomize overlay/composition root |
| `platform/hpc-ubiq/slurm/nfs` | Kustomize overlay/composition root |
